title: entityMetricComparison
responsibility: Pairs current and first-parent Page measurements when both revisions contain the active Page, excluding helper, removed and non-Page views.

inputs.name: entityMetricComparison.host
inputs.description: The viewed revision, optional first-parent revision and explorer route used to determine whether a Page comparison applies.

inputs.name: entityMetricComparison.entity
inputs.description: The viewed entity; comparisons require an active Page in both registries and exclude entities shown from a removed revision.

inputs.name: entityMetricComparison.measure
inputs.description: The caller-provided current measurement profile to pair with measurements derived from the parent revision.

inputs.name: entityMetricComparison.helper
inputs.description: Optional selected helper name; a nonempty helper selection disables whole-Page measurement comparison.

outputs.name: entityMetricComparison
outputs.description: Current and first-parent commit/profile pairs, including eligible parent focused observations; null when the view or registry entries do not permit comparison.
